task: Implement retry_delay(value, now, cap=60.0). Parse an HTTP Retry-After value as either ASCII decimal integer seconds (surrounding whitespace allowed) or an RFC HTTP date via email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime. now is an aware datetime. Return seconds clamped to [0, cap] as a float. Missing, malformed, negative, fractional or naive-date values return None. A nonfinite or negative cap raises ValueError even when value is missing. Past valid dates return 0.0. Do not read the wall clock; use the supplied now.
